name: @agntux/agntux-slack-mcp-server
description: Local MCP server for the agntux-slack plugin. Exposes compose_view and canvas_view render tools for the Slack reply-compose and canvas-summary MCP App UI handlers.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --target=node18 --sourcemap --banner:js='import { createRequire as _esmCreateRequire } from "module"; const require = _esmCreateRequire(import.meta.url);' && node scripts/embed-bundle.mjs
